title: Make fusion outputs behave like true two-image fusions (not just color/overlay edits)

requirements.text: Update the on-device fusion generator so outputs are true fusions derived from BOTH Photo A and Photo B (a combined composite/collage/merge), not primarily global color adjustments or a simple uniform overlay; ensure the generator frequently exchanges/merges localized structures/textures between the two inputs (e.g., patch-based region mixing + edge-aware blending) so the result visibly contains meaningful elements from each input.

quotes: Do you know what a fusion is why don't you look it up and that's what I want

acceptanceCriteria: Generating fusion outputs produces images where both Photo A and Photo B are visibly represented (not just a tint/temperature shift of one photo).
At least one fusion technique used by the generator performs localized region mixing (not a full-frame uniform blend) and uses edge-aware blending/feathering to avoid harsh seams.
The fusion pipeline reduces reliance on global hue rotation/saturation/noise as the primary differentiator between outputs.

requirements.text: Add an on-device “both-inputs” contribution guard to detect and prevent outputs that are effectively identical to just Photo A or just Photo B (aside from minor global color/contrast changes); when detected, automatically retry with a different fusion recipe/seed until a maximum retry count is reached, then show a clear English error message if it cannot produce a valid fusion.

quotes: Do you know what a fusion is why don't you look it up and that's what I want

acceptanceCriteria: If a generated output is too similar to either input image, the app automatically retries generation rather than returning the near-duplicate result.
After exhausting retries, the user sees an English error explaining that the app could not produce a valid fusion from the chosen photos and suggesting trying different photos.
Regenerating a hidden output also uses the contribution guard and does not return near-duplicates of either input.

requirements.text: Update Upload/Generate page user-facing copy to define “fusion” in plain English as a combined result derived from BOTH photos (not a filter), and align button/section descriptions accordingly without introducing new workflow steps.

quotes: Do you know what a fusion is why don't you look it up and that's what I want

acceptanceCriteria: The Upload/Generate page describes fusion as combining/merging two photos into one new output and explicitly indicates both photos contribute.
All updated copy is in English and does not reference single-photo variation generation.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and all files under frontend/src/components/ui.
No external AI services or external backends; fusion must remain fully on-device in the browser.
Respect the existing single-actor Motoko backend architecture; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Adding a new third photo input or multi-image (3+) fusion.
Adding real-time collaboration, chat, or any websocket-based features.
Introducing external image generation APIs or cloud processing.
